learning_objective: 🎯 Grab your stopwatches! Let us learn how to measure super short times using minutes and seconds to track fast races!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A second is a very fast measurement of time, like a single heartbeat or a quick blink. It takes exactly 60 seconds to make up just 1 minute!
When athletes run a fast 100-meter sprint, we use a stopwatch to count the exact seconds it takes them to cross the finish line.
If a fun game takes 2 minutes, we can use multiplication to find the seconds. Just multiply 2 by 60, and we know it takes 120 seconds!

fun_activity.title: ⏱️ The 10-Second Challenge
fun_activity.instructions: Use a clock with a second hand. See how many times you can write your own name neatly in exactly 10 seconds!

quick_recap: ⭐ A second is a very tiny and quick piece of time.
⭐ There are exactly 60 seconds hiding inside 1 minute.
⭐ Stopwatches help us measure races down to the exact second!
